description:
Title: Work Accident

Create a process that helps in gathering information about work accidents (and almost work accidents):
For insured gainful employment, a work accident is considered to be an accident that occurs in the following circumstances, by way of example:
* the accident occurs in a location, at a time and with a cause that correlates to the insured employment
* when working from home
* on the direct route from the permanent place of residence to work, to lunch or on the way home, whereby carpools are also protected
* for training sessions that serve to provide specific professional knowledge, whereby an accident on to way to or from the training centre is considered a work accident
* on the direct route from home, or from the workplace or training centre to a doctor and back, if this interrupts the direct route from the permanent place of residence to work or the route home (the doctor's visit must be notified to the employer in advance)
* on the way to or from the workplace or training centre with the purpose of taking a child to or collecting them from a childcare facility, a daycare facility, external care or a school, insofar as they have a supervisory responsibility for the child
* when making use of advocacy groups or professional associations (e.g. Chamber of Labour, trade union federation, guild etc.)

For kindergarten children, schoolchildren and students, an accident is considered to be a work accident if, amongst other things
* the accident occurs in a location, at a time and with a cause that correlates to the school or university education or the compulsory kindergarten year that forms the basis of the insurance
* when taking part in a school event or school-related event 
* on the direct route from the child's place of residence or permanent accommodation to kindergarten or a school visit or on the way home
* when performing a practical task prescribed as part of the curriculum and/or the study regulations or 
* in certain professional (training) orientations.

In an agricultural or forestry establishment, accidents can be considered work accidents if they do not occur directly while performing the insured employment.
Depending on the protected group of people, the following tasks are covered by accident insurance:
* working in the household of the owner of the company and/or the employee, if the household serves the company to a considerable extent
* working in connection with providing accommodation for guests 
* secondary occupations for the sale of agricultural products from the farm
* working in the context of erecting, converting and repairing buildings that serve the agricultural and forestry establishment
* working in the context of neighbourhood assistance for another agricultural and forestry establishment  

Certain accidents are considered the same as work accidents and in many cases can also affect people who do not have accident insurance.
Accidents that occur in one of the following situations, among others, are considered to be work accidents outside of professional activity:
* for activities with which services from the Unemployment Insurance Act / Labor Market Promotion Act are being made use of (e.g. on the way to an arranged job interview)
* when assisting with an accident or donating blood
* when receiving training, taking part in exercises or serving as a member of one of the following aid organisations:
    * Volunteer fire brigade
    * Volunteer water rescue service
    * Volunteer rescue organisations
    * Austrian Red Cross
    * Austrian Alpine Rescue Service
    * Austrian Water Rescue
    * Austrian Rescue Dog Brigade
    * Avalanche warning committees
    * Air rescue service
    * Radiation detection and survey crews

The employees must inform the employer immediately of:
* any work accident
* any incident that would almost have led to an accident
* any serious and immediate risk to safety and health that they discover
* any defect discovered in protection systems.

The employer must, in turn, immediately report any work accident that leads to a fatality or serious injury to the Labour Inspectorate, if it has not been reported to the emergency services.

Independent of this, every work accident in which a person with accident insurance has been killed, or injured in such a way that they are unable to work for three days, in full or in part, must be reported to the responsible accident insurance provider within five days.

As a self-employed person, please ensure that you not only report accidents involving people you employ but also those that involve you to the accident insurance provider in good time.

Students and schoolchildren should report accidents to the competent directorate.
Schools, educational facilities and universities are obliged to report every work accident through which a person with accident insurance is physically injured or killed within a maximum of five days to the responsible accident insurance provider in triplicate.

In the case of private insurance, the insured party must report an accident in writing immediately in line with the conditions and to avoid the provider from being released from the obligation to perform.
If there are fatalities, this must be reported within three days, even if the accident has already been reported.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_WorkAccident" targetNamespace="https://example.org/bpmn/work-accident">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_LabourInspectorate" name="Work accident report to Labour Inspectorate"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_AccidentInsurance" name="Accident report to accident insurance provider"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Directorate" name="Accident report to competent directorate"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PrivateInsurer" name="Written accident report to private insurer"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_WorkAccident">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_WorkAccident" name="Work Accident reporting process" processRef="Process_WorkAccident"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_LabourInspectorate" name="Labour Inspectorate"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_AccidentInsurance" name="Responsible accident insurance provider"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Directorate" name="Competent directorate"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_PrivateInsurer" name="Private insurance provider"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_LabourInspectorate" name="Report fatal or serious work accident" sourceRef="Task_ReportInspectorate" targetRef="Participant_LabourInspectorate" messageRef="Message_LabourInspectorate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_EmployerInsurance" name="Report qualifying work accident within five days" sourceRef="Task_ReportEmployerInsurance" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurance" messageRef="Message_AccidentInsurance"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SelfEmployedInsurance" name="Report accidents involving self or employees" sourceRef="Task_ReportSelfEmployedInsurance" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurance" messageRef="Message_AccidentInsurance"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SchoolInsurance" name="Report in triplicate within five days" sourceRef="Task_ReportSchoolInsurance" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurance" messageRef="Message_AccidentInsurance"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Directorate" name="Report accident to competent directorate" sourceRef="Task_ReportDirectorate" targetRef="Participant_Directorate" messageRef="Message_Directorate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PrivateInsurerImmediate" name="Immediate written accident report" sourceRef="Task_ReportPrivateInsurer" targetRef="Participant_PrivateInsurer" messageRef="Message_PrivateInsurer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PrivateInsurerFatal" name="Fatality report within three days" sourceRef="Task_ReportPrivateFatality" targetRef="Participant_PrivateInsurer" messageRef="Message_PrivateInsurer"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_WorkAccident" name="Work Accident" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Incident" name="Accident or safety concern identified"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherInformation" name="Gather accident circumstances">
      <bpmn:documentation>Record information relevant to whether the event is covered and to the applicable reporting duties. For insured gainful employment, examples include an accident at a place, time and with a cause connected to the employment; working from home; direct journeys between residence, work, lunch or home (including carpools); qualifying professional training and journeys to or from training; notified visits to a doctor on the stated routes; journeys for taking a supervised child to or collecting them from childcare, daycare, external care or school; and use of advocacy groups or professional associations. For kindergarten children, schoolchildren and students, examples include circumstances connected to the insured education or compulsory kindergarten year; school or school-related events; direct journeys between residence or permanent accommodation and kindergarten or school; curriculum or study-regulation practical tasks; and certain professional training orientations. Agricultural and forestry coverage can also include household work serving the establishment to a considerable extent, guest accommodation, secondary sales of farm products, construction or repair of buildings serving the establishment, and neighbourhood assistance for another such establishment. Accidents outside professional activity may also be treated as work accidents, including activities using services under the Unemployment Insurance Act or Labor Market Promotion Act, assistance at an accident or blood donation, and specified training, exercises or service with the listed volunteer aid organisations.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReportingRoutes" name="Select applicable reporting duties"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EmployeeNotifyEmployer" name="Inform employer immediately"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_EmployerDuties" name="Check employer reporting duties"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InspectorateEligibility" name="Fatality or serious injury?"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_EmergencyReported" name="Already reported to emergency services?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportInspectorate" name="Report to Labour Inspectorate immediately"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InspectorateMerge" name="Continue employer reporting"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportEmployerInsurance" name="Report qualifying accident to accident insurance within five days"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_EmployerDutiesJoin" name="Complete applicable employer reports"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReportSelfEmployedInsurance" name="Ensure timely accident insurance report for self or employees"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportDirectorate" name="Report accident to competent directorate"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportSchoolInsurance" name="Report school accident to accident insurance in triplicate within five days"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportPrivateInsurer" name="Report accident to private insurer in writing immediately"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PrivateFatality" name="Fatality?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportPrivateFatality" name="Report fatality to private insurer within three days"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PrivateMerge" name="Complete private insurance reporting"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReportingRoutesJoin" name="Complete applicable reporting duties"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ReportingComplete" name="Applicable reporting duties completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Gather" sourceRef="StartEvent_Incident" targetRef="Task_GatherInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Gather_Routes" sourceRef="Task_GatherInformation" targetRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutes"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Routes_Employee" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutes" targetRef="Task_EmployeeNotifyEmployer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Employee work accident, near miss, discovered serious and immediate safety or health risk, or discovered defect in a protection system</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Routes_SelfEmployed" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutes" targetRef="Task_ReportSelfEmployedInsurance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Self-employed person has an accident involving themself or a person they employ</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Routes_Student" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutes" targetRef="Task_ReportDirectorate">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Student or schoolchild accident requiring report to the competent directorate</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Routes_School" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutes" targetRef="Task_ReportSchoolInsurance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">School, educational facility or university accident physically injures or kills a person with accident insurance</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Routes_Private" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutes" targetRef="Task_ReportPrivateInsurer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Private insurance applies to the accident</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_EmployerDuties" sourceRef="Task_EmployeeNotifyEmployer" targetRef="Gateway_EmployerDuties"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmployerDuties_Inspectorate" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployerDuties" targetRef="Gateway_InspectorateEligibility">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Accident leads to a fatality or serious injury</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmployerDuties_Insurance" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployerDuties" targetRef="Task_ReportEmployerInsurance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Work accident kills a person with accident insurance or causes such injury that the person is unable to work for at least three days, in full or in part</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InspectorateEligibility_EmergencyCheck" sourceRef="Gateway_InspectorateEligibility" targetRef="Gateway_EmergencyReported">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Yes</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmergencyReported_Inspectorate" sourceRef="Gateway_EmergencyReported" targetRef="Gateway_InspectorateMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Yes, already reported to emergency services</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmergencyNotReported_Inspectorate" sourceRef="Gateway_EmergencyReported" targetRef="Task_ReportInspectorate">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">No, not reported to emergency services</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InspectorateReport_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ReportInspectorate" targetRef="Gateway_InspectorateMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InspectorateMerge_DutiesJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_InspectorateMerge" targetRef="Gateway_EmployerDutiesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmployerInsurance_DutiesJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReportEmployerInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_EmployerDutiesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmployerDutiesJoin_RoutesJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployerDutiesJoin" targetRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutesJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelfEmployed_RoutesJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReportSelfEmployedInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Directorate_RoutesJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReportDirectorate" targetRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SchoolInsurance_RoutesJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReportSchoolInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Private_Report_FatalityCheck" sourceRef="Task_ReportPrivateInsurer" targetRef="Gateway_PrivateFatality"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateFatality_Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_PrivateFatality" targetRef="Task_ReportPrivateFatality">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Fatality</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateFatality_No" sourceRef="Gateway_PrivateFatality" targetRef="Gateway_PrivateMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">No fatality</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateFatalityReport_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ReportPrivateFatality" targetRef="Gateway_PrivateMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateMerge_RoutesJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_PrivateMerge" targetRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RoutesJoin_End" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutesJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_ReportingComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
